formulas.V2: integral_.5^Z K = .5*integral_(1-Z)^Z K forZ>.5; zero otherwise
formulas.V1: integral_0^Z z*K = V2 + integral_0^(1-Z) z*K forZ>.5

interpretation: Mode2 implements the symmetric finite-daughter interval and partly compensates the forward/PDF boundary mismatch. It does not supply the full x/PDF-dependent missing g-to-q tail.
limitations: Massless light-quark forward integrals at one central Born point; not a new full-shower run.
